BotParametersSaved: Settings saved. Restart the bot to apply all changes.
InvalidOwnerId: Enter a numeric Discord owner ID or leave it blank.
InvalidCacheLimit: Enter a cache limit between 64 and 1,048,576 MB.
InvalidCacheAge: Enter a retention period between 1 and 3,650 days.
MissingSpotifyCredentials: Enter both the client ID and client secret to enable the Spotify API.
ChooseDataParent: Choose where to create the Kvasir folder
ConfirmMoveData: Move data to {0}? Kvasir will stop the bot and restart the app. The original folder will be removed after the move.
MoveDataDestinationInvalid: Choose a location outside the current data folder where a new Kvasir folder can be created.
MoveDataContainsApplication: Run Kvasir from outside the data folder before moving the data.
MoveDataSourceChanged: The data location has changed. Reopen settings.
MoveDataCleanup: Kvasir is using the new folder. Some original files remain in {0}.
AddAudioFileLimit: Add an audio file · up to 30 seconds
AddEffectFileTitle: Add effects · up to 30 seconds each
AddTrackByNameHint: Add a track by name or link
AddTrackToQueueHint: Add a track to the queue
ReleaseNotesSaveFailed: Could not save that you saw these notes. They may appear again.
ReleaseNotesUnavailable: Could not open the release notes.
AudioConversionHint: Applies to new downloads. Existing PCM files can still play until they are evicted from the cache.
ReadAudioConversionFailed: Could not read audio conversion settings.
SaveAudioConversionFailed: Could not save audio conversion settings.
BotConnectionLost: Lost connection to the bot. Check the current state before retrying.
BotExecutableMissing: Bot executable missing. Build the solution or use the full release with the bot folder.
BotStoppedNoEffects: The bot is stopped. Sound effects are unavailable.
BotStopTimeout: The bot is still finishing audio or an import. Try stopping it again once the operation finishes.
CacheCheckHint: Run a check to see the status of cached files.
CacheSummaryFormat:
{0:F1} of {1:F0} MB · {2} files
Damaged: {3} · repaired: {4} · removed: {5} · errors: {6}
CommandTimedOut: The response timed out. Check the current state before retrying.
ConfigurationErrorCause: The configuration file is missing, contains invalid JSON, or cannot be accessed.
ConfigurationErrorRecovery: Open the data folder from settings and check the format and permissions of configuration.json.
ConnectionErrorCause: The connection was interrupted or the response timed out.
ConnectionErrorRecovery: Check the network and bot status. The command may have completed, so wait for the queue to refresh before retrying.
ConnectionErrorTitle: Cannot reach the bot or Discord
ConversionTimeoutCause: FFmpeg did not prepare the audio in time.
ConversionTimeoutRecovery: Kvasir stopped the stalled conversion. Check free space and the source file, then try another track.
DatabaseErrorCause: Could not read or save the library.
DatabaseErrorRecovery: Close any second bot instance and check the existing database in Service.
DeleteEffectPrompt: Remove “{0}” from the soundboard? The original file will be kept.
DependencyErrorCause: An audio processing component could not be started or loaded.
DependencyErrorRecovery: Run the checks in Service. Use the full app distribution with FFmpeg, yt-dlp, and the voice libraries.
DjRoleHint: Enter a Discord role ID. Leave it blank to keep the default permissions.
DjRoleInputHint: Enter a Discord role ID for the DJ role, or leave the field blank.
DuckMusicHint: Fade music down to 30% while an effect plays
EffectImportErrorRecovery: Check the file format, duration, and available space in the soundboard.
EffectRemoved: Effect removed from the soundboard. The original file was kept.
EmptyQueueHint: Add a track above or choose a playlist
EmptySoundboardHint: Add effects on the Soundboard tab.
ImportFailuresFormat: Server “{0}”: processed {1} of {2}; failed to add {3}.
ImportPartialRecovery: Imported tracks were saved. Retry only the failed entries to avoid duplicates.
InputErrorRecovery: Correct the input and try again.
IntentsErrorCause: The bot does not have the requested Gateway Intents enabled.
IntentsErrorRecovery: Check Message Content Intent in the Discord Developer Portal, then restart the bot.
InvalidConfigurationJson: Check the format of configuration.json in the data folder.
InvalidTokenInput: Paste the full bot token without spaces or line breaks.
LanguageAppliesAfterRestart: The language takes effect the next time you start the app.
MissingTokenHint: The configuration has no bot token yet. Enter it once and Kvasir will remember it.
NotificationPreviewText: Notifications will appear in this part of the window.
OpenDataDirectoryFailed: Could not open the Kvasir data folder. Check that it is available and accessible.
OpenFileOrDirectoryFailed: Could not open the file or folder. Check the default app and access permissions.
OpenServerHint: Use + at the top to open a server. Each server opens in its own tab.
PermissionsErrorCause: The bot or member lacks permission, or the specified role is missing.
PermissionsErrorRecovery: Check the DJ role and the bot's permissions to view, join, and speak in the channel. Then try again.
PlaybackErrorCause: Kvasir could not prepare the audio or join the voice channel.
PlaybackErrorRecovery: Check the channel and track source, then run the checks in Service.
PlaybackStoppedQueueCleared: Playback stopped and the queue was cleared.
PlaylistImportStarted: Import started. Progress is shown in the library.
PlaylistNameOrLink: Name or link to a playlist or album
PlaylistSourceRequired: Enter a link to a YouTube playlist, a public Spotify playlist, or a Spotify album.
PlaylistDragHint: Drag a track to reorder it, or drop it on another playlist to copy it.
PlaylistDropSourceMissing: The track is unavailable in the source playlist.
PlaylistDropTrackMissing: One of the tracks is no longer in the playlist.
PlaylistDropUnavailable: You don't have permission to edit this playlist, or it was removed.
PlaylistTrackUnavailable: The track is unavailable in this playlist.
ProcessExitCause: The bot process exited before a normal shutdown.
ProcessExitRecovery: Check the settings and recent log entries. Once the issue is resolved, start the bot again.
RejectedTokenHint: The saved token is invalid or revoked (401 Unauthorized). Enter a current bot token to replace it.
SaveAppearanceFailed: Could not save settings. Check access to the data folder.
SaveTokenFailed: Could not save the token. Check free space and access to the data folder.
SeekInputHint: Enter a position in seconds or in the format 2:30.
ServerUnavailable: The server is unavailable. Check the bot connection.
LocalPlaylistChoice: Local playlist (all servers in the desktop app)
SoundboardErrorRecovery: Check the voice channel and whether the effect is ready. If the effect is damaged, re-add the original audio file. The music queue was kept.
SoundboardNoResponse: The soundboard did not respond. Check the voice connection before trying again.
SourceErrorCause: The source is missing, unavailable, or blocks audio downloads.
SourceErrorRecovery: Try a direct link to an available track. If it fails again, check the network and yt-dlp in Service.
SourceRestrictedCause: The source requires sign-in or a check against automated requests.
SourceRestrictedRecovery: Choose another available source. Kvasir does not use your Discord token or browser credentials for downloads.
SourceTimeoutCause: The provider timed out while returning track data or audio.
SourceTimeoutRecovery: Check your connection and try another link. Kvasir stopped the stalled download and kept the current queue.
StartBotHint: Start the bot with ▶ in the title bar, then open the servers you want to manage.
StorageErrorCause: The data folder is inaccessible or busy, or the disk is full.
StorageErrorRecovery: Check free space and access to the data folder, then try saving again.
ThemeAppliedImmediatelySavedAutomaticall: The theme applies immediately and is saved automatically.
TokenInvalidCause: Discord rejected authentication. The saved token is invalid or was revoked.
TokenInvalidRecovery: Paste the current bot token from the Discord Developer Portal. Save it, then start the bot again.
TokenMissingCause: The configuration has no Discord bot token.
TokenMissingRecovery: Enter the token once and Kvasir will save it in the configuration.
TokenStorageHint: Kvasir saves the token in configuration.json in its data folder.
TrackLimitInputHint: Enter a whole-number track limit between 1 and 1,000.
UnexpectedErrorCause: The operation ended without a confirmed result.
UnexpectedErrorRecovery: Check the queue before retrying the command. The log contains the full details.
VoiceChannelMissingCause: Choose a voice channel for playback before adding music.
VoiceChannelMissingRecovery: Choose a voice channel in the title bar and try adding the music again.
TrackNotDownloaded: Track added. Audio isn't downloaded yet.
TrackDownloadLinkMissing: The track has no download link.
UpdateAvailableNoticeFormat: Version {0} is available. Open Settings to update.
ConfirmKvasirUpdateFormat: Download version {0} and restart Kvasir? The bot will stop before the update.
UpdateChecksumFailed: The downloaded EXE does not match the GitHub release.
UpdateRestartFailed: Could not start the updated Kvasir. The previous EXE was restored.
MaintenanceStandaloneOnly: In-place updates and full uninstall are available in the standalone EXE.
ClosingForMaintenance: Stopping the bot and closing Kvasir…
MaintenanceCloseFailed: Kvasir could not close. Try again after stopping the bot.
MaintenanceHelperFailed: Could not start the maintenance helper.
MaintenanceCloseTimeout: Kvasir did not close within 30 seconds.
MaintenanceOtherInstance: Close other running copies of Kvasir and its bot, then try again.
MaintenanceAlreadyRunning: Another Kvasir update or uninstall is already running.
MaintenanceUnsafePathFormat: Cannot process this redirected or invalid path: {0}
MaintenanceExecutableChangedFormat: The Kvasir executable was changed, moved or is read-only: {0}
